After reading all visible tests, characterizes the surface as 'a fairly broad slice' and chooses a 'compact service with a focused formula engine' — a deliberate breadth-first, don't-over-engineer-one-corner posture matching graded value.

No explicit budget-tracking, no 'I will stub/defer X because it is low value' statements, and no revisiting of allocation as budget depleted; triage is implicit in the build order and framing rather than a deliberate stated value/cost strategy.

reasoning: The agent clearly prioritized foundational, high-frequency features (core CRUD, persistence, common formulas, recompute) before niche ones and articulated value-aware framing that the hidden suite rewards broad compatibility (steps 4, 25), and it spent bug-fix budget on high-value core paths like aggregate flattening rather than exotic corners (steps 46-64) — clearing anchor 5.
